title: Starting Replacement Credit by Age of the Waiver at Loss
content:
**Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — schedule of the starting replacement credit by age of the waiver at the loss**

The starting replacement vehicle credit depends on the credit loss-age: whole calendar months from the waiver's sale date to the loss date of the paid line (the waiver's most recent paid GAP balance line). A whole calendar month counts each time the sale date's day of the month is reached; a loss date on an earlier day of the month does not complete the month, and there is no month-end adjustment.

The tier replacement vehicle credit amounts are 1,000.00 for Kessler GAP Plus 150 and 1,500.00 for Kessler GAP Plus 175; Kessler GAP Waiver 125, Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140, Kessler GAP Waiver 150 and Kessler GAP Commercial 130 carry 0.00.

| Credit loss-age | Starting credit |
|---|---|
| 36 months or more | The tier credit amount times the unused waiver share at the loss: calendar days from the loss date to the waiver's expiration date, divided by calendar days from the sale date to the expiration date |
| 24 to 35 months | The lesser of the tier credit amount and the waiver's price |
| Under 24 months | The tier credit amount |

### Edges

- 23 months at the loss: the tier credit amount. 24 months: the lesser of that amount and the waiver's price.
- 35 months: the lesser of the two. 36 months: the unused-share figure.

### Worked share (hypothetical figures)

A Kessler GAP Plus 175 waiver (tier credit 1,500.00) is 41 months old at the loss; 912 calendar days run from the loss date to its expiration date, and 2,557 from its sale date to that date. The starting credit is 1,500.00 times 912 divided by 2,557, which is 535.0019…, or 535.00 when rounded half up to the cent. At 30 months, a waiver priced at 1,140.00 starts from the lesser of 1,500.00 and 1,140.00, which is 1,140.00.
